summary.en: Army drones have struck displaced persons camps in South Wollo and Amhara, killing civilians including children, while armed clashes between Oromo and Somali groups in Moyale have forced thousands to flee into Kenya. Gunfire is being heard near the Ethiopian-Kenya border as civilians continue to evacuate, and Ethiopia and Eritrea have now severed diplomatic ties, raising regional tension. Russian Su-35 fighter jets and S-400 air defence systems have been deployed in Ethiopia as fighting spreads across Tigray, Amhara and Oromia. The UCDP recorded 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Fano insurgency
background.extract: The Fano insurgency is an armed conflict and insurgency in the Amhara Region of Ethiopia that began in April 2023 between the Fano militia and the Ethiopian government. The conflict started after the government attempted to dissolve the Amhara Special Forces and other regional forces as part of a plan to reform and centralize the country's security apparatus, and integrate them into the federal armed forces. This move led to protests and armed resistance by local forces under Fano.
